result_text:
I changed the per-rep purchase order count so it leaves out cancelled purchase orders. The change is one line in `src/main/java/com/acme/backoffice/DataStore.java`, in the `PURCHASE_ORDERS` entry of `CustomerAttributedRecords` (around line 5831). The exclusion was empty, and the doc comment said cancelled purchase orders were counted on purpose. It now adds `AND po.status <> 'CANCELLED'`, matching the per-quarter report, and the comment is updated to say they are not counted.

**Side effect you should know about:** that enum entry is also used by `findPurchaseOrderCountPerCountry`, so the per-country purchase order report (`CountryPurchaseOrdersService`) will now exclude cancelled purchase orders too. You didn't ask for that. If you want the per-country report unchanged, I can split the exclusion out for the per-rep path only.

Verification: `mvn -q -o test -Dtest=SalesRepPurchaseOrderCountTest,CountryPurchaseOrdersTest` ran with no output, which means it passed. I did not run the full suite. Nothing is committed.
